snapshot.title: Time Jump: 11:00 — Incident Escalation

fields.narration: It is now 11:00. The problem has spread to multiple systems and public channels. The Early Vote Center line is now 45 people long. The spoofed notice has been shared on 12 local Facebook groups. The hotline has received 137 calls in 30 minutes. The IT team has confirmed the account compromise, but no one has declared an incident level yet. Operations are operating in manual mode on unverified data.
worldState: The Early Vote Center line remains at 45 people.
The spoofed notice about Polling Location 6 moving to Carrow Middle School has been shared on 12 local Facebook groups.
The hotline has received 137 calls in the past 30 minutes.
The IT team has confirmed the compromise of Nina Ruiz’s account.
No formal incident level has been declared.
Operations continue in manual mode using unverified data.
